module: Central container of Road Architect: it stores the list of the session's roads (each road = nodes, lateral profile, display options, bridge, tunnels) and provides all the editing operations (adding/removing nodes, moving, height, lateral rotation, cutting, flipping, copying, serialization). It also handles the transition between the "edit" and "finalised" states (creation of procedural meshes, static meshes, tunnels and decals). A modder uses it to create or manipulate roads by script from the editor; the Road Architect modules (geometry, profiles, decals, roadMesh...) read its tables.
usage:
local roads = extensions.editor_roadArchitect_roads
local idx = #roads.roads + 1
roads.roads[idx] = roads.createRoadFromTemplate('Two Lane')  -- profile template name (example)
roads.map[roads.roads[idx].name] = idx
roads.addNodeToRoad(idx, vec3(0, 0, 0))
roads.addNodeToRoad(idx, vec3(50, 0, 0))
roads.updateRoads()
notes: A road is a table (fields: name, displayName (im.ArrayChar), nodes, profile, isVis/isDirty..., renderData, tunnels, groupIdx). Many parameters are ImGui pointers (im.BoolPtr, im.FloatPtr, im.IntPtr): read/write with [0].
A node = {p (vec3), isLocked, rot (FloatPtr, degrees), widths/heightsL/heightsR (FloatPtr tables keyed by lane key, -20..20), incircleRad, isAutoBanked, offset}.
Internal limits: node height bounded to ±1000 m, lateral rotation bounded to ±50 degrees, local width (setLocalWidth) bounded to [0.5, 10] m per lane.
createRoadFromProfile/createRoadFromTemplate only return the road table: they do NOT add it to roads.roads or roads.map (see convertDecalRoads2RoadArchitect for manual addition).
Modified roads are marked isDirty via setDirty; updateRoads() then recomputes their renderData (roads with fewer than 2 nodes are ignored).
A road named 'temp' (isHidden = true) is used to preview profiles (manageTempRoadSection).
BUG/inconsistency: M.isAuditionProfileDirty is a boolean copy frozen at load time (the real flag is a local variable); reading this field does not give the current state.
BUG probable: reparameteriseDecalRoad (internal) uses `while isError or iter > maxIter` (the bound is inverted) and builds its width points with pp1.x/pp1.y for all points.
BUG probable: updateBridgeParameters does im.FloatPtr(road.bridgeWidth) whereas bridgeWidth is already a FloatPtr ([0] would be needed).

convertDecalRoads2RoadArchitect: the comment says the original DecalRoads are deleted, but the sel:delete() call is commented out in the code; the function therefore does not delete them. Moreover it does not add it to roadMap via recomputeMap.

roads.desc: List of the session's roads (same table as the one used internally: modifying it acts directly).

map.desc: Hash table road name -> index in roads. Rebuilt by recomputeMap().

multi.desc: Multi-selection of nodes: each entry gives the road index (r) and node index (n).

isAuditionProfileDirty.desc: Initial copy (false) of the profile audition flag; see notes, the real value is not exposed.

getCurrentMap.desc: Returns the name/identifier of the map (level) currently stored by the module.

returns.desc: Value stored by setCurrentMap (nil at start).

createRoadFromProfile.desc: Builds a new road table from a lateral profile (updates the profile's lane flags, computes the lane keys). The road has no nodes and is not added to the list.

returns.desc: The created road (default values: visible, 15 radial tunnel divisions, bridge half-width 5.5, depth 4, arch -6, etc.).

createRoadFromTemplate.desc: Like createRoadFromProfile, but the profile is created from the name of a profile template (with an identifier generated by Engine.generateUUID()).

computeRoadAABB_2D.desc: Computes the axis-aligned 2D bounding box of a road's nodes (used only by the acceleration tree).

setDirty.desc: Marks the road as needing recomputation (isDirty), updates the profile condition and reinserts the road into the editing quadtree (created on demand with the terrain extent, or 5000 m by default).

getTree.desc: Returns the 2D quadtree used for display culling while editing (nil if it does not exist yet).

removeTree.desc: Forgets the quadtree (it will be recreated on the next setDirty).

setAuditionProfileDirty.desc: Requests the rebuild of the temporary profile audition road on the next call of manageTempRoadSection.

addNodeToRoad.desc: Adds a node at the end of the road, with the per-lane widths/heights from the profile. Marks the road dirty.

rIdx.desc: Index of the road in roads.

addNodeToRoadAtIdx.desc: Inserts a node at the given index of the road. Marks the road dirty.

isMouseAtIntermediatePos.desc: Tests whether the mouse position is close (2D tolerance 3.5 m) to a segment of the road, between two nodes, to offer node insertion.

returns.desc: true if the mouse is over a segment.
Index of the node following the point found.

setLocalWidth.desc: Changes the width of all 'road_lane' type lanes of a node: new width = starting width + offset, bounded to [0.5, 10].

copyNode.desc: Deep copy of a node (new ImGui pointers and new vec3).

updateWAndHToNewProfile.desc: Resets the per-lane widths and heights of all the road's nodes according to its current profile (after a profile change).

computeAABB2D.desc: 2D bounding box of a road's nodes. Returns nil for a bridge or an overlay. (The comment says the profile width is included, but the code only takes the nodes into account.)

getRoadsFromGroup.desc: Returns the roads (without duplicates) belonging to a placed group; if group is nil, returns all the session's roads.

group.desc: Group with group.list = list of entries {r = road name, n = node index}.

recomputeMap.desc: Rebuilds the name -> index table (roads.map). To be called after any manual insertion/removal in roads.

removeRoad.desc: Deletes a road by its name: removes decals, road and static meshes, quadtree entry, possible bridge folder, then the entry in roads and rebuilds the map.

roadName.desc: Name (identifier) of the road, not its displayName.

removeNode.desc: Removes a node from a road (table.remove). Does not mark the road dirty.

addIntermediateNode.desc: Adds a node between the selected node and its neighbor (midpoint, averaged values). At the ends of the road, copies the node and places it 3 m further along the road axis.

lie.desc: 'above' (with the previous node) or 'below' (with the next node).

clearAllRoads.desc: Deletes all roads that are not junction roads (isJctRoad).

removeHiddenRoads.desc: Removes from roads all hidden roads (isHidden) and their meshes, then recomputes the map.

goToRoad.desc: Places the free camera directly above the center of the road, at a height that frames the whole road (according to the field of view). Does nothing if the road is too small (less than 0.1 m extent).

moveRoad.desc: Translates a road: either rigidly (all unlocked nodes), or as a force field (the central node follows the mouse, the others move proportionally to the distance, up to the first locked node). Marks the road dirty.

adjustHeight.desc: Changes the height of a node (bounded to ±1000 m) and propagates the change to the other nodes (rigid or force field). Marks dirty.

hNew.desc: New height of the central node, in meters.

hOld.desc: Old height (used to compute the change dz).

adjustLateralRotation.desc: Changes the lateral rotation (banking) of a node and propagates it to the others (bounded to ±50 degrees). No effect if the profile is in auto-banking.

rotNew.desc: New rotation of the central node, in degrees.

copyRoad.desc: Deep copy of a road (nodes, profile, options, bridge/tunnel parameters). The name is kept identical, renderData is emptied, tunnels is empty and isDirty = true.

splitRoad.desc: Cuts a road at the given node into two new roads ([A] and [B], each with a copy of the cut node pushed back by 1 m), deletes the old road and adds them to roads. Useful for creating junctions.

nIdx.desc: Index of the cut node; must have a neighbor on each side (the code reads nodes[nIdx-1] and nodes[nIdx+1]).

flipRoad.desc: Reverses the direction of the road (node order) and immediately recomputes its renderData. Useful for fixing imports.

updateRoads.desc: Recomputes the renderData of each dirty road having at least 2 nodes; for bridges, also updates the bridge mesh in the scene folder "Road Architect - Bridge <name>". To be called every editing frame.

clearBridges.desc: Empties the bridges table of the roadMesh module (without deleting the scene objects).

removeAll.desc: Deletes all decals, road meshes, statics, bridges and tunnels, then empties roads and the map.

manageTempRoadSection.desc: Creates or updates the temporary road 'temp' (20 m straight segment at 1000 m altitude) that shows the profile being edited, places the free camera on it and makes it rotate around. Called every frame during the audition.

pIdx.desc: Index of the profile in profileMgr.profiles.

updateBridgeParameters.desc: Applies the road's bridge width and depth to the first two nodes (lanes -1 and 1). See notes: probable pointer bug.

createMultiSelect.desc: Fills roads.multi with all the nodes of all roads located inside the polygon (in 2D).

getMultiSelectionCentroid.desc: Center of the 3D bounding box of the multi-selection nodes.

returns.desc: Center (nonsensical values if the selection is empty).

computeAllRoadRenderData.desc: Recomputes the renderData of all roads with 2 or more nodes (via geometry).

computeRoadRenderDataSingle.desc: Recomputes the renderData of a single road.

removeGroupFromRoad.desc: Removes a placed group index from the road's groupIdx list.

updateRoadsAfterRemovingGroup.desc: Rebuilds the groupIdx of all roads from the list of remaining placed groups (renumbering after a group is deleted).

placedGroups.desc: List of placed groups, each with list = {{r = name, n = index}, ...}.

updateMultiAfterRemove.desc: Removes from roads.multi the entries whose road or node no longer exists.

convertDecalRoads2RoadArchitect.desc: For each DecalRoad selected in the editor, creates a Road Architect road (re-parameterized nodes, profile according to lanesLeft/lanesRight) and adds it to roads. See notes: the DecalRoads are not deleted.

offsetRoads2Terrain.desc: Enables isConformRoadToTerrain on all roads (they sit on the terrain) and marks them dirty.

offsetByValue.desc: Adds a vertical offset to all nodes of all roads and marks them dirty.

finalise.desc: Switches to the "finalised" state: recomputes all renderData, creates a scene folder per road ("Road Architect - Road <i>"), generates the bridge meshes then road meshes, the static meshes and the tunnels, reloads the collision (be:reloadCollision), places the decals then reloads the navgraph (map.reset()).

unfinalise.desc: Leaves the "finalised" state: removes the decals, meshes, statics and tunnels generated by finalise and goes back to editing.

setRoadsVisibilityMaster.desc: Shows or hides all ordinary roads (neither bridges nor overlays) by overwriting their isVis.

serialiseRoad.desc: Converts a road to a plain table (plain values, without ImGui pointers) for JSON saving.

deserialiseRoad.desc: Rebuilds a road (with ImGui pointers, isDirty = true) from a table serialized by serialiseRoad.
